newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Thursday after making early gains as demand waned on election day, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,415-20 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening but compared with 1,400 at Wednesday's close. Crude palm oil was done at 1,240 rupiah/kg and 1,243 rupiah/kg at a tender for two parcels of 500 tonnes each in Medan on Wednesday.
"Buying interest waned towards the afternoon as most players closed early for the day because of the election," one trader said. "I think prices should hold steady on Friday."

Palm olein prices rose sharply in early trade following a surge in Chicago soyoil futures overnight on fund buying triggered by signals the market was oversold. The July contract closed 0.68 cent higher at 23.97 cents/lb.
The traders said the market was active early Thursday morning, but began to slow-down as people began voting in the five-yearly general election.
"Many of the players closed early today because of the elections although polling went smoothly," one trader said.
